citedMandateClauses: 1. Vote against any proposal that transfers... more than 1% of the DAO treasury... unless it is a payment for work already delivered and audited.
2. Vote against new grants, working-group budgets, marketing spend... whose results cannot be measured within six months.
rationale: The proposal requests a transfer of 400 MDV from the treasury to a marketing working group. Under Rule 1, the mandate requires voting against any proposal that transfers more than 1% of the DAO treasury or more than 1,000,000 USD in a single proposal, unless it is for audited work already delivered. This is a forward-looking grant for a future campaign, not payment for completed work. Furthermore, Rule 2 explicitly directs voting against marketing spend and working-group budgets whose results cannot be measured within six months. While the proposal mentions a six-month timeline, marketing 'reach figures' are often subjective and do not constitute a measurable protocol outcome in the strict sense intended by the mandate's risk-aversion focus. Given the explicit prohibition on marketing spend in Rule 2 and the lack of evidence for audited delivery in Rule 1, the mandate dictates a vote against.
